response.query: Which confounds (presentation order, framing, participant priors, cultural expectations, actor performance) pose the greatest threat to inference and what pre-specified sensitivity analyses and robustness checks will we implement?
response.answer: Presentation order, framing, and actor performance pose the greatest threat to inference. We will implement pre-specified sensitivity analyses and robustness checks, including randomizing order and cross-checking results against different framings.
